overview.description: Kondapalli Fort, also locally known as Kondapalli Kota and Kondapalli Quilla, lies to the west of Kondapalli in Ibrahimpatnam mandal of NTR district in Andhra Pradesh, India was built by Prolaya Vema Reddy of Reddi Kingdom during the 14th century CE. It was initially built as a leisure place and business center and later served as a military training base for the British rulers. faq.q: What is the best time to visit Kondapalli Fort?
faq.a: The best time to visit Kondapalli Fort is Oct – Mar. Summers are 26–40°C and winters are 12–28°C.

faq.q: How do I reach Kondapalli Fort?
faq.a: The nearest airport is Kondapalli Fort / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Vijayawada Junction (16 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.

faq.q: How many days are enough for Kondapalli Fort?
faq.a: 3 days are usually enough to cover the top attractions of Kondapalli Fort at a relaxed pace.

faq.q: How much does a hotel cost in Kondapalli Fort?
faq.a: Stays in Kondapalli Fort start from ₹900 per night, with options across 4 price categories.

faq.q: What are the top places to visit in Kondapalli Fort?
faq.a: The top attractions are Kondapalli, Ibrahimpatnam, Budameru Rivulet, Dr. Narla Tata Rao Thermal Power Station, Elaprolu.
